purpose: Locate L0 FC1 long-scoreboard PCs and their ordinary L1TEX-backed load/consumer dependencies; no TMA or service causality assumed.
candidate: Original frozen metadata-ready M128, PDL=True; not new route-cache candidate
sampling_period_cycles: auto: record actual selected interval for each kernel; no interval sweep
retained_work: All complete-graph predecessors, native activation, FC2, finalizer, live metadata and typed PDL edges still execute. Only FC1 selected.

adequacy_proposal.overflow_or_dropped_samples: Report inconclusive; no automatic interval/launch-count change.
adequacy_proposal.caveat: Thresholds are heuristic descriptive adequacy checks, not independent-sample confidence bounds.

stop: First source/semantic/ownership/sampling-support failure; no automatic repeats, period sweep, whole-graph, eager stand-in or runtime promotion. 600s/process, only designated GPU after ownership reassignment.
analysis: Keep sample-count denominator per PC and per kernel. Map top PCs to exact captured SASS and trace dependencies backward to source when defensible; distinguish route-map scalar LDG, scale dependency, TMEM consumer, and unresolved cases. PC denotes stalled instruction, not necessarily producer.
source_candidate: FC1 scale producer repeatedly loads same route row across16K128 iterations; source-backed hypothesis only. Existing isolated route-cache prototype is separately owned/validated; sampling does not substitute its complete-call gate.
sampling_policy: Installed default auto interval, max one warp-sampling pass; inadequate samples are INCONCLUSIVE, never automatic repeats.
pc_mapping_contract: Use metric.correlation_ids().as_uint64(i) for each metric instance; resolve each address through action.sass_by_pc(address)/source_info(address), then match exact function+CUBIN and saved instruction offset. Do not assume a module VA base or map by instruction-text similarity. If offset convention or SASS cannot be reconciled, label unmapped and INCONCLUSIVE.
